title: Hyderabad Pharmaceuticals & APIs: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
So when a proposal lands, check the customer-wise sales split and the facility-wise USFDA status before you look at the balance sheet. [8][10]

## What has changed now
**The local tailwind is real but the sector signal is not: Telangana GST is up 13.8% Apr-to-date against India's 6.1%, and state power demand is up 15.7% against 9.5% nationally [D].** Against that, India-wide output is down 2.1% Apr-to-date while bank credit is up 21.6% YoY, a 23.7 pp gap [D] — money is chasing a shrinking output base. In Hyderabad specifically, Granules' Gagillapur finished-dosage site drew 11 USFDA observations on 30-Oct-2026, its first inspection since a February 2025 warning letter; none were data-integrity or cross-contamination, and manufacturing is unaffected [1][2]. **Read that as a documentation-and-investigation problem, not a shutdown — but it is the second adverse event at one site in two years.**

## Where the growth is
**Peer results show the money is in API and CDMO, not plain dosage: Aarti Pharmalabs posted record quarterly revenue of Rs. 613 crore, up 47% YoY, with EBITDA margin at 22.2% [4][6], and RPG Life Sciences is targeting 25% API growth with another acquisition within 12 months [5].** RPG's own Q2 revenue rose 16.5% to Rs. 211.6 crore yet the stock fell over 10% [7] — the market is pricing quality of earnings, not topline. Pursue Hyderabad API and intermediate makers with multi-customer order books and CDMO contracts; avoid single-customer CRAMS units, where one US client loss hits revenue hard [8]. ## How to grow safely
**Structure against the working-capital cycle, which is the real risk: Concord's working capital intensity ran 47-52% of sales even after improvement [10].** Take monthly stock-and-receivable statements, a receivables-ageing covenant, and a USFDA status declaration each quarter. Where a borrower has fund-based limits, track utilisation — Cohance's fell from 70-90% to 40-50% in Q1FY25 [9], which is a genuine signal of order slowdown, not prudence. Ask for facility-wise inspection history; if any site is under a warning letter, ask for the remediation timeline and hold limit enhancement. ## Early-warning signs
**Watch for a second 483 at the same site, receivable days stretching past the stated cycle, and customer concentration above half of sales [8][10].** Note that the rating sources here are undated and pre-date FY26 — treat them as structural, not current. Hyderabad-specific borrower data is thin in these sources; lean on first principles and the peer numbers above.

## Verdict for the desk
**Caution, not avoid: the Telangana demand signals [D] support selective lending, but the credit-to-output gap [D] and the Granules observations [1] mean we underwrite facility quality and customer spread, not the city's growth story.**
